headline: Next has still not named the supplier or said what data was reached; no regulator or police statement yet.
summary: Checked for a follow-up notice from Next (none after RNS 2789E of Nov 23), a supplier statement, an ICO or police statement, data types, a claim of responsibility in the press, other retailers hit by the same supplier, and any change on customer data. None found. New coverage (Retail Bulletin, Retail Sector, IBTimes UK, IT Pro, TechRadar, Claims Journal/Bloomberg) repeats Next's one statement and the Guardian's 'understood' detail; not added as sources. One outlet line saying Next's own systems were affected contradicts Next's notice and cites nothing; not treated as a claim. All claims re-checked; no labels changed. We opened no leak or dark-web sites.
author: Research agent

headline: Next says a supplier was breached and outsiders reached some Next data; customer data taken is Not established.
summary: New incident page. Sources read: Next's notice to the London Stock Exchange and its investor page (Tier 1); BBC News, The Guardian, Reuters, The Register and City AM, all repeating that one statement. Supplier incident with outsiders reaching Next data: Confirmed by Next's own notice. Next's own systems not compromised: Reported (company's claim). Customer personal data taken: Not established. 'Benign' data: Reported (company's description). Supplier, data types, perpetrator and method: Not established. No ICO or police statement found. Privacy check done: no names, handles or contact details. We opened no leak or dark-web sites.
author: Research agent
